correctness.rationale: A root reduction by the unique critical vertex makes the set finite and exact; the least-unused-face recursion exhausts every possible perfect Hasse matching once. Both a reversed-Hasse Kahn DAG checker and a separate Forman V-path checker independently count 117837 candidate perfect matchings, 76025 acyclic, and identical 24 symmetry-fixed counts. Burnside and the orbit-stabilizer theorem convert these into all stated exact counts. Neither partial enumeration nor timeout is treated as a proof.

value.rationale: The orbit/stabilizer decomposition is a natural missing invariant of optimal gradients: 380125 labelled matchings do not determine the quotient by the full S5 automorphism group. The sharp split into 3107 free orbits, two nonconjugate C2 types, seven S3 orbits and one fully symmetric orbit is a substantive exact classification of equivalence types, not a repackaging of the known f-vector. It addresses the smallest simplex dimension for which the published enumeration required a cluster computation. The result is finite, and no unrelated downstream theorem is asserted.
